entries.f89826285ada8f4a: It is a company headquartered in Hirakawacho, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, that conducts housing finance business centered on lending housing loans. Its parent company, SBI Holdings, Inc., indirectly owns 62.91% of the voting rights (as of March 31, 2026). It has six consolidated subsidiaries and 522 employees, and conducts its business through 90 locations nationwide and non-face-to-face channels.
